Players Committee card image of [[Profundity (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploys -2 to a system opponent occupies (-4 if opponent's system). May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 3 starfighters, 3 vehicles, and 1 corvette. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/profundity_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c 12d0bca] (12 December 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
